_notes: Paseo worktree lifecycle. MAIN resolves the main checkout from the worktree's git-common-dir — no machine paths hardcoded.
../mantle symlink is required by link:../mantle/packages/* deps and by scripts that invoke ../mantle/packages/cli/dist/index.mjs directly; it must point at a BUILT mantle checkout.
.env holds SOPS/TF_VAR secrets (gitignored, no .env.example) — copied from main checkout. The age key lives outside the repo (~/.config/sops/age/keys.txt) and is shared.
pnpm build runs decrypt-cookies.sh and needs that age key; yt-dlp/ffmpeg binaries download on demand (pnpm update:ytdlp / update:ffmpeg).
tfstate is remote (S3 + DynamoDB lock) — safe across worktrees; run `cd infra && terraform init` only for infra work.

Teardown stops this worktree's compose project (localstack + test postgres). Host ports and container names are per-worktree: bin/worktree-ports.sh (sourced by localstack:* / test:integration / bin scripts) derives a deterministic offset from the worktree path, so integration tests CAN run concurrently across worktrees; a bare main checkout keeps the defaults 4566/5432/5433 and the fixed container names.

setup: MAIN="$(dirname "$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)")" && { cp "$MAIN/.env" .env 2>/dev/null || true; } && { cp "$MAIN/.envrc" .envrc 2>/dev/null || true; }
teardown: . bin/worktree-ports.sh && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml down -v >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
